title: Stochastic Difference-of-Convex Optimization with Momentum
abstract: arXiv:2510.17503v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study the online stochastic difference-of-convex (DC) program $\min_{x \in R^n} F(x) = G(x) - H(x) + r_1(x) - r_2(x)$, which covers sparse learning with nonconvex penalties, robust regression with smooth robust losses, and non-negative positive--unlabeled learning. We propose \emph{momentum-based DCA} (MDCA), which combines a damped DCA step with a momentum estimator for $\nabla H$ and uses a constant per-iteration batch size. With exact solutions of the convex subproblems, MDCA with Polyak momentum uses $\mathcal{O}( \epsilon^{-4})$ stochastic gradients of $H$ to reach $\epsilon$-stationarity, and momentum-based variance reduction (MVR) uses $\mathcal{O}(\epsilon^{-3})$ under averaged smoothness, with a single $\mathcal O(\epsilon^{-1})$ warm-up batch in place of the periodic large batches of DCA-PAGE, whose $\epsilon$-dependence it matches. We also introduce a single-loop variant (S-MDCA) that replaces the subproblem solve

translated_title: 带动量的随机凸差优化
translated_abstract: 我们研究在线随机凸差规划问题 $\min_{x \in R^n} F(x) = G(x) - H(x) + r_1(x) - r_2(x)$，该类问题涵盖了带非凸惩罚项的稀疏学习、带光滑鲁棒损失的鲁棒回归，以及非负正例-未标注学习。我们提出了基于动量的DCA算法，该方法将阻尼DCA步骤与针对 $\nabla H$ 的动量估计器相结合，并采用固定的每迭代批次大小。在凸子问题可精确求解的情况下，采用Polyak动量的MDCA只需 $\mathcal{O}(\epsilon^{-4})$ 个 $H$ 的随机梯度即可达到 $\epsilon$-稳定性，而基于动量的方差缩减算法在平均光滑性条件下仅需 $\mathcal{O}(\epsilon^{-3})$，并且用单个 $\mathcal{O}(\epsilon^{-1})$ 的预热批次取代了DCA-PAGE的周期性大批次，同时匹配了其关于 $\epsilon$ 的复杂度依赖性。我们还引入了单循环变体（S-MDCA），用以替代子问题的求解
tldr: 本文提出基于动量的随机凸差优化算法MDCA，将阻尼DCA步骤与动量估计器结合，在稀疏学习、鲁棒回归等非凸优化问题上以更少的随机梯度调用次数达到与DCA-PAGE相当的稳定性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MDCA, a momentum-based stochastic difference-of-convex optimization algorithm that combines damped DCA steps with momentum estimators, achieving stationarity with fewer stochastic gradient evaluations than DCA-PAGE by using a single warm-up batch for nonconvex problems such as sparse learning and robust regression.
